description: Fetch full metadata for a single weather station by its ID (e.g., "GHCND:USW00024233", "COOP:010008"). Returns name, coordinates, elevation, and the full date range for which data is available. Use when you have a station ID from noaa_climate_find_stations and want its complete details, or to verify a station before querying data.

stationId.description: Station ID to fetch (e.g., "GHCND:USW00024233", "COOP:010008"). Obtain from noaa_climate_find_stations.

name: noaa_climate_get_station

datacoverage.description: Fractional data coverage (0–1). Omitted when not provided by the API.

elevation.description: Station elevation. Unit depends on elevationUnit. Omitted when not provided.

elevationUnit.description: Unit for elevation (e.g., "Meters"). Omitted when not provided.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: Station ID format is valid but no station exists with that ID. `service_unavailable`: NOAA CDO API is unreachable or returning errors. `rate_limited`: NOAA CDO throttled the request — the configured token went over its rate limit. `upstream_auth_failed`: NOAA CDO rejected the API token this server is configured with. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

latitude.description: Station latitude in decimal degrees. Omitted when not provided by the API.

longitude.description: Station longitude in decimal degrees. Omitted when not provided by the API.

maxdate.description: Latest date data is available at this station (YYYY-MM-DD). Omitted when not provided.

mindate.description: Earliest date data is available at this station (YYYY-MM-DD). Omitted when not provided.

title: Get NOAA Climate Station
